pr_title: add cluster and node data to enriched envelope source
pr_body:
This adds the fields cluster_id, cluster_name, db_version, job_id,
node_name, node_id and source_node_locality to the source for
changefeed messages with enriched envelope that specify "source".

Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/139690

Epic: [CRDB-8665](https://cockroachlabs.atlassian.net/browse/CRDB-8665)

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/141388)

issue_context.title: Metadata/Enriched envelope: Implement "node/cluster info" source fields
issue_context.body:
Implement "node/cluster info" source fields: db_version, cluster_name, source_node_locality, node_name, node_id.

Epic CRDB-8665

Jira issue: CRDB-46773

review_comments: i dont think this is the right place for this / the right factoring. you're stripping source now too, and also asserting things about it

Yeah, I didn't like this but was having trouble coming up with the right split. I think I will change this "includeSource" argument to be a function and then move the unmarshalling of the json into assertPayloadsBaseErr. There I'll call both stripTS and also the passed function on this unmarshaled json and remarshal it. Does that sound reasonable?
can you update `getAvroFields` / `avroSourceFunction`? ideally you'd have them not able to fall out of sync with each other
